verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review agent automatically reviews every PR (including presumably agent-authored ones from its own Agents feature) with no manual configuration, catching bugs and suggesting fixes at scale (docs-4, docs-16, docs-18, docs-19). However, the evidence never explicitly addresses reviewing AI-generated code specifically or claims about handling volumes beyond human review capacity, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of review accuracy or throughput. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scale/volume handling beyond a single team, independent verification of review quality on agent-authored PRs, and any benchmark or case study demonstrating it catches issues human reviewers would miss at scale.
